selection_rule: enumerate every dependency-ready todo task by priority, reconcile each mapped GitHub issue/claim/PR with oracc_tf.coordination, post a lease claim, immediately re-read GitHub, and proceed only if that session owns the winning claim; losing sessions reselect unrelated ready work
